name: storyboard-writer
description: Writes the concept as a storyboard the user would live, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run storyboard-writer", "storyboard this concept", "show the idea as a story", "write the frames for the illustrator", or a concept needs to be felt as an experience before anyone commits to building it. Use it even for "how would this actually feel to use".
